en: A declaration, such as is customarily prefixed to a writing in a preface — about the purpose that the author has set himself in it, as well as about the occasions and the relation in which he believes it to stand to other earlier or contemporary treatments of the same subject — seems, in the case of a philosophical writing, to be not only superfluous but, by the nature of the matter, even inappropriate and contrary to its purpose.

For how and what of philosophy it would be fitting to say in a preface — for instance a historical statement of the tendency and the standpoint, of the general content and the results, a combination of assertions and assurances about the true that talk back and forth — cannot count as the manner in which philosophical truth is to be presented.

Also, because philosophy is essentially in the element of universality, which encloses the particular within itself, the semblance occurs in its case more than in other sciences that in the purpose or the final results the matter itself, and even in its consummate essence, were expressed, in contrast to which the execution would properly be the unessential.

In the general representation, by contrast, of what e.g. anatomy is — say, the cognition of the parts of the body considered according to their lifeless determinate being — one is convinced that one does not yet possess the matter itself, the content of this science, but must besides strive for the particular.

— Further, with such an aggregate of cognitions, which does not rightly bear the name of science, a conversation about purpose and similar generalities tends to be no different from the historical and concept-less manner in which the content itself, these nerves, muscles and so on, is also spoken of.
In the case of philosophy, by contrast, the inconsistency would arise that such a manner would be made use of and yet would be shown by philosophy itself to be incapable of grasping the truth.
zh: 那种照习惯在序言里预先给一部作品加上的说明——关于作者在这部作品里给自己定下的目的，也关于那些起因，以及他认为这部作品与同一对象的其他较早或同时的论述处在怎样的关系之中——，在一部哲学著作那里看来不只是多余的，而且由于事情的本性，甚至是不合适的、违背目的的。
因为在一篇序言里怎样谈哲学、谈些什么才算得体——比如历史性地交代倾向和立场、一般内容和结果，把关于真的东西来回说个不停的那些主张和保证凑在一起——，并不能算作哲学真理应当被展示出来的那种方式。
又因为哲学本质上处在普遍性这一要素里，而普遍性把特殊包含在自身之中，所以在哲学这里比在其他科学那里更会出现一种假象，好像目的或最后结果里就已经把事情本身表达出来了，甚至是把它完满的本质表达出来了，相比之下，实际的展开本来反倒是非本质的东西。
相反，在一般表象里，比如解剖学是什么——大约就是就身体各部位无生命的定在来看对它们的认识——，人们确信自己还没有占有事情本身、还没有占有这门科学的内容，而是此外还必须去为特殊的东西费力气。
——此外，对于这样一堆并不正当地拥有科学之名的知识来说，关于目的和诸如此类的普遍性所作的交谈，通常与那种历史性的、无概念的方式没有什么不同，而就连内容本身，这些神经、肌肉等等，也是用那种方式被谈到的。
而在哲学这里却会出现这样的不一致：人们采用了这样一种方式，可哲学自己又指出这种方式没有能力把握真理。

en: Thus, too, through the determination of the relation that a philosophical work believes it has to other endeavours concerning the same subject, a foreign interest is drawn in and that on which everything depends in the cognition of truth is obscured.

However firm the opposition of the true and the false becomes for opinion, it also tends to expect either assent or contradiction with regard to an existing philosophical system, and in a declaration about such a system to see only either the one or the other.
It does not so much comprehend the diversity of philosophical systems as the progressive development of truth, as it sees in the diversity only contradiction.

The bud disappears in the breaking forth of the blossom, and one could say that the former is refuted by the latter; in the same way, through the fruit the blossom is declared to be a false determinate being of the plant, and as its truth the fruit steps into the place of the blossom.
These forms not only differ from one another, but also displace one another as incompatible with each other.

But their fluid nature makes them at the same time moments of the organic unity, in which they not only do not conflict with each other, but the one is as necessary as the other, and it is this same necessity that first constitutes the life of the whole.

But the contradiction against a philosophical system tends, on the one hand, not to comprehend itself in this way, and on the other hand the comprehending consciousness commonly does not know how to free it from its one-sidedness, or to keep it free, and to recognize in the shape of what seems to be in strife and opposed to itself mutually necessary moments.
zh: 同样，凭借确定一部哲学著作认为自己与同一对象上的其他努力有着怎样的关系，也会把一种异样的兴趣牵扯进来，并且把在真理的认识上真正要紧的东西弄模糊。
对意见来说，真的东西和假的东西的对立无论变得多么牢固，它也总是要么期待赞同一个现成的哲学体系、要么期待与它相矛盾，并且在一份关于这样一个体系的说明里只看到二者之一。
它并不那么以概念把哲学体系的多样性把握为真理的向前发展，而是在多样性里只看到矛盾。
花蕾在花朵绽开时消失，人们可以说，花蕾被花朵驳倒了；同样，通过果实，花朵被说成是植物的一种虚假的定在，而果实作为花朵的真理，取代了花朵的位置。
这些形态不仅彼此不同，而且还作为彼此不能相容的东西互相排挤。
但它们的流动本性同时又使它们成为有机统一体的环节，在有机统一体里，它们不仅互不冲突，而且这一个和那一个同样必然，正是这种同等的必然性才构成了整体的生命。
但针对一个哲学体系的矛盾，一方面通常并不用这种方式以概念把握自己，另一方面，进行把握的意识一般也不知道怎样把它从自己的片面性里解脱出来、或者让它保持自由，并在那种显得在争斗、显得彼此抵触的形态里认出互相必然的环节。

en: The demand for such declarations, as well as the satisfactions of them, easily pass for pursuing what is essential.

Wherein could the inner element of a philosophical writing be more expressed than in its purposes and results, and whereby could these be more determinately cognized than through their difference from what the age otherwise brings forth in the same sphere?

But if such a doing is to count for more than the beginning of cognition, if it is to count as actual cognition, then it is in fact to be reckoned among the inventions for going around the matter itself and combining the two — the semblance of seriousness and effort about it and the actual sparing of the same,

— For the matter is not exhausted in its purpose, but in its execution; nor is the result the actual whole, but rather it together with its becoming; the purpose for itself is the lifeless universal, just as the tendency is mere drive, which still lacks its actuality, and the bare result is the corpse that has left the tendency behind it.
— Likewise, difference is rather the boundary of the matter; it is there where the matter ceases, or it is what the matter is not.
Such efforts with the purpose or the results, as well as with the differences and judgements of the one and the other, are therefore an easier work than they perhaps seem.

For instead of occupying itself with the matter, such a doing is always beyond it; instead of lingering in it and forgetting itself in it, such knowing always reaches for another and remains rather with itself than that it is with the matter and gives itself over to it.
— The easiest is to judge what has content and solidity; harder, to grasp it; the hardest, to bring forth the presentation of what unites both.
zh: 对这类说明的要求，以及对这类要求的满足，很容易被看作是在致力于本质的东西。
一部哲学著作的内在东西，还能在哪里比在它的目的和结果里表达得更充分呢，而除了通过它们与这个时代在同一领域里另外产生出来的东西的差别，还能靠什么更确定地认识它们呢？
但如果这样一种做法应当算作比认识的开端更多的东西，如果它应当算作现实的认识活动，那它就确实要算进那些发明里去：绕开事情本身，并且把这两者结合起来——围着它显得认真、显得费力的那副假象，和实际上省掉这份力气，
——因为事情并不在它的目的里就被穷尽，而是在它的展开里；结果也不是现实的整体，而是结果连同它的生成；目的自为地看是无生命的普遍东西，正如倾向是单纯的奔忙、还缺少自己的现实性，而赤裸的结果则是把倾向抛在身后的尸体。
——同样，差别毋宁说是事情的界限；差别就在事情停止的地方，或者说，差别就是事情所不是的东西。
因此，围绕目的或结果、以及围绕这一个和那一个的差别和评判所做的这类努力，是一件比它们看起来也许更容易的工作。
因为这样的做法不是在跟事情打交道，而是始终在事情之外；这样的知识不是在事情里停留、在事情里忘掉自己，而是始终去抓另一个东西，与其说它是在事情那里、把自己交给事情，不如说它始终待在自己那里。
——最容易的是评判有内涵和有分量的东西，较难的是把握它，最难的是为那统一了两者的东西做出展示。

en: The beginning of formation and of working oneself out of the immediacy of substantial life will always have to be made with acquiring cognitions of general principles and points of view, with raising oneself first only to the thought of the matter in general, no less with supporting or refuting it with grounds, with grasping the concrete and rich fullness according to determinacies, and with knowing how to give an orderly account and a serious judgement about it.

But this beginning of formation will first give way to the seriousness of fulfilled life, which leads into the experience of the matter itself; and even if this is added besides, that the seriousness of the concept descends into its depth, such cognition and judgement will keep its proper place in conversation.
zh: 教养以及从实体性生命的直接性里挣脱出来的开始，将总是必须从这些事做起：获得关于一般原理和视角的知识，首先只把自己提升到对事情一般的思考，同样也要用根据去支持或反驳它，按照各种规定性去把握那具体而丰富的充实，并且懂得对它作出有条理的说明和认真的判断。
但教养的这个开始首先会让位给那充实了的生命的严肃，这种严肃把人带进对事情本身的经验；而即使再加上这样一点，即概念的严肃深入到事情的深处，这样一种知识和评判也会在交谈中保住它恰当的位置。

en: The true shape in which truth exists can only be the scientific system of it.

To work along with this, that philosophy may come closer to the form of science — to the goal of being able to lay aside the name of love of knowing and to be actual knowing — that is what I have set before myself.
The inner necessity that knowing be science lies in its nature, and the satisfactory explanation of this is solely the presentation of philosophy itself.

The external necessity, however, insofar as it is grasped in a general way apart from the contingency of the person and of individual occasions, is the same as the inner one, namely in the shape in which time presents the determinate being of its moments.

That the elevation of philosophy to science is timely — to show this would therefore be the only true justification of the attempts that have this purpose, because they demonstrate its necessity; indeed, it would at the same time carry that purpose out.
zh: 真理在其中存在的那种真正的形态，只能是真理的科学体系。
为使哲学更接近科学的形式——接近那个目标：能够放下“对知识的爱”这个名字，成为现实的知识——而一起出力，这就是我给自己定下的。
知识是科学，这一内在的必然性就在知识的本性里，而关于这一点的令人满意的说明，只能是哲学本身的展示。
而外在的必然性，只要它撇开人格上的偶然性和个体的起因、被以一般的方式来看，就是与内在的必然性同一个东西，也就是说，处在时间把它的各环节的定在呈现出来的那种形态里。
哲学的提升为科学正是时候，要指出这一点，因此就会是那些抱着这个目的的尝试的唯一真正的辩护，因为这些尝试证明了这件事的必然性，甚至这种指出同时就会把这个目的实行出来。

en: Insofar as the true shape of truth is placed in this scientific character — or, what is the same, insofar as it is asserted that truth has the element of its existence in the concept alone —, I know that this seems to stand in contradiction with a representation and its consequences, and this representation has as great a presumption as it has diffusion in the conviction of the age.
An explanation of this contradiction therefore seems not superfluous; even if here it can be nothing further than likewise an assurance, like that against which it is directed.

For if the true exists only in that, or rather only as that, which is now called intuition, now immediate knowledge of the absolute, religion, being — not in the centre of divine love, but the being of the same itself —, then from there, at the same time, for the exposition of philosophy the opposite of the form of the concept is rather demanded.
The absolute is not to be comprehended, but felt and intuited; not its concept, but its feeling and intuition shall do the talking and be expressed.
zh: 既然真理的真的形态被置于这种科学性之中——或者，同一回事，既然有人主张真理只在概念里才有它存在的要素——，那么我就知道，这看起来是与一种表象及其后果相矛盾的，而这种表象在时代的信念中散布得有多广，它的僭妄就有多大。
因此，对这个矛盾作一个说明看来并非多余；即使它在这里所能做的，也无非同样是作出一个保证，跟它所针对的那个东西一样。
因为，如果真的东西只存在于那个东西之中，或者更确切地说，只作为那个东西而存在——那个东西时而被叫作直观，时而被叫作对绝对者的直接知识、宗教、存在，而这存在不是处在神圣之爱的中心，而是绝对者本身的存在——，那么从那里出发，为着哲学的阐述，就反倒要求与概念的形式相反的东西。
绝对者不应被用概念去把握，而应被感觉和直观；不是它的概念，而是它的感觉和直观应当来说话，并被说出来。

en: If the appearance of such a demand is grasped in its more general context and seen at the stage on which self-conscious spirit presently stands, then it is beyond the substantial life that it formerly led in the element of thought — beyond this immediacy of its faith, beyond the satisfaction and security of the certainty that consciousness possessed of its reconciliation with the essence and of the latter's universal, inner and outer, presence.
It has not only gone beyond that into the other extreme of the substance-less reflection of itself in itself, but also beyond this.
Its essential life is not only lost to it; it is also conscious of this loss and of the finitude that is its content.

Turning away from the husks, confessing that it lies in evil and railing at it, it now demands of philosophy not so much the knowledge of what it is as rather to attain, through philosophy, once again to the restoration of that substantiality and of the solidity of being.

To this need, therefore, philosophy is to open up not so much the closedness of substance and raise it to self-consciousness, not so much bring chaotic consciousness back to thought-out order and to the simplicity of the concept, as rather to pour together the separations of thought, to suppress the distinguishing concept, and to produce the feeling of the essence — granting not so much insight as edification.

The beautiful, the holy, the eternal, religion and love are the bait that is demanded in order to awaken the desire to bite; not the concept, but ecstasy, not the coldly progressing necessity of the matter, but fermenting enthusiasm is to be the sustaining and onward-leading expansion of the wealth of substance.
zh: 如果把这样一种要求的现象放到它更一般的联系中去把握，并且对照自我意识着的精神目前所站的那个阶段来看，那么它就已经超出了它从前在思想的要素里所过的那种实体性的生活——超出了它信仰的这种直接性，超出了意识对其与本质、以及本质那种普遍的、内在和外在的当前在场的和解所曾拥有的那种确定性的满足和安稳。
它不仅越过了这一点，进入它自身在自身中反思的那种无实体的另一个极端，而且连这个极端也越过了。
它本质性的生命不仅对它来说已经失去；它还意识到这种失去，也意识到那作为它内容的有限性。
从豆荚那里转身走开，承认自己陷在恶里并对此大骂，它现在向哲学所要求的，与其说是对它自身是什么的知识，不如说是要重新通过哲学才达到那种实体性和存在的坚实性的恢复。
所以，对这种需要，哲学与其说应当打开实体的封闭性、把它提升为自我意识，与其说应当把混沌的意识带回到被思考的秩序和概念的单纯性，不如说应当把思想的种种区分倒在一起，压制那作出区分的概念，制造出对本质的感觉，与其说给予识见，不如说给予陶冶。
美、神圣、永恒之物，还有宗教和爱，就是人们所要求的诱饵，好唤起咬钩的兴致；不是概念，而是迷狂，不是事情冷冰冰地向前推进的必然性，而是发酵般的热情，才应当是实体财富的保持和向前引导的展开。

en: Corresponding to this demand is the strained and almost zealously and irritably self-showing effort to tear human beings out of their sunkenness in the sensuous, the common and the singular, and to raise their gaze to the stars; as if they, entirely forgetting the divine, were about to satisfy themselves with dust and water, like the worm.
Formerly they had furnished a heaven with a copious wealth of thoughts and images.

Of everything that is, the meaning lay in the thread of light by which it was tied to heaven; along it, instead of lingering in this present, the gaze glided beyond it, up to the divine essence, to a — if one may say so — other-worldly present.

The eye of the spirit had to be forcibly directed at the earthly and held fast to it; and it took a long time to work that clarity, which only the other-worldly had, into the dullness and confusion in which the sense of the this-worldly lay, and to make attention to the present as such, which was called experience, interesting and valid.
— Now the need of the opposite seems present, the sense so firmly rooted in the earthly that it takes equal force to raise it above that.
Spirit shows itself so poor that, like the wanderer in the sand desert after a simple drink of water, it seems to long only for the meagre feeling of the divine in general, for its refreshment.
By that with which spirit is satisfied, the magnitude of its loss is to be measured.
zh: 与这一要求相应的，是那种紧张的、几乎显得热心而恼怒的努力，要把人从沉溺于感性之物、平庸之物和个别之物的状态中拽出来，把他们的目光抬向星辰；仿佛他们完全忘了神圣之物，像虫子那样，靠尘土和水就要满足了。
从前，他们曾用思想和图像的广阔财富把一个天装点起来。
对于一切存在的东西，意义就在那条把它系在天上的光线里；目光沿着这条光线，不是停留在当前，而是越过当前向上滑去，滑向神圣的本质，滑向一种——如果可以这么说的话——彼岸的当前。
精神的眼睛必须被强行转向尘世的东西，并被牢牢保持在上面；而且需要很长的时间，才能把那种只有超尘世的东西才有的明晰性贯注进此岸的东西的意义所藏身的那种昏暗和混乱之中，并且使那种对当前的东西本身的注意——它当时被称为经验——变得有趣并具有效力。
——现在似乎出现了相反一方的困境，意义在尘世的东西里扎根得那么深，以至于需要同样的强力才能把它提升到尘世之上。
精神显得如此贫乏，以至于它就像沙漠里的旅人渴望一口清水那样，似乎只渴望那种对一般神圣之物的贫乏感觉，好让自己振作起来。
从精神所满足的那一点上，就可以衡量出它损失的大小。

en: This contentment in receiving, or thrift in giving, does not befit science.

Whoever seeks only edification, whoever wants to wrap the earthly manifoldness of his determinate being and of thought in fog and longs for the indeterminate enjoyment of this indeterminate divinity, may see to it where he finds this; he will easily find the means to rave to himself about something and thereby to puff himself up.
But philosophy must beware of wanting to be edifying.
zh: 这种在接受上的知足，或者说在给予上的吝啬，并不适合科学。
谁只寻求陶冶，谁想把自己的定在和思想的尘世杂多裹进雾里，渴求这种不确定的神性所带来的不确定的享受，那就让他自己去看他在哪里能找到这些吧；他会很容易找到办法，对自己把什么东西天花乱坠地吹上一通，并借此自我膨胀。
但哲学必须当心，不要想去具有陶冶作用。

en: Still less must this contentment, which renounces science, make the claim that such enthusiasm and turbidity is something higher than science.

This prophetic talk thinks it stays right in the centre and in the depth, looks contemptuously upon determinacy (Horos) and deliberately keeps itself away from the concept and necessity as from reflection, which dwells only in finitude.

But just as there is an empty breadth, so too an empty depth; as there is an extension of substance that pours itself out into finite manifoldness without the force to hold it together, so there is a content-less intensity which, holding itself as pure force without expansion, is the same as superficiality.
The force of spirit is only as great as its expression, its depth only as deep as it dares to spread itself out and lose itself in its interpretation.

At the same time, if this concept-less substantial knowing pretends to have sunk the ownness of the self in the essence and to philosophize in a true and holy way, then it hides from itself that, instead of being devoted to God, through its disdain of measure and determinacy it rather lets now the contingency of the content prevail in itself, now its own arbitrariness in Him.

— In surrendering themselves to the unbridled fermentation of substance, they think that, by wrapping up self-consciousness and giving up the understanding, they are His own, those to whom God gives wisdom in sleep; what they thus in fact receive and give birth to in sleep are therefore also dreams.
zh: 这种对科学弃而不顾的知足，就更不应当声称这种热情和浑浊是比科学更高的东西。
这种预言式的言谈自以为正好待在中心和深处，轻蔑地看着规定性（Horos），并且故意让自己远离概念和必然性，把它们当作只栖身于有限性之中的反思。
但正如有一种空洞的广度，也有一种空洞的深度；正如实体有一种延展，它把自己倾泻到有限的杂多之中，却没有力把这些杂多保持在一起，同样也有一种没有内涵的强度，它作为没有广延的纯然之力而持存，与肤浅是同一个东西。
精神的力只有它的表现那么大，它的深度也只有当它敢于在自己的阐释中展开自己、失去自己时才有那么深。
同时，如果这种无概念的实体性知识自称已经把自我的本己性沉入本质之中，并且以真的、神圣的方式做哲学，那么它就对自己隐瞒了一点：它并不是献身于神，而是由于鄙弃尺度和规定，反倒只是时而在自身之内放任内容的偶然性，时而在神之中放任自己的任意。
——他们既然把自己交给实体那种未被驯服的发酵，就以为靠着把自我意识包裹起来、放弃知性，自己就是属他的人，是神在睡梦中赐予智慧的那些人；他们这样实际上在睡梦中接受和生出的东西，因此也不过是梦。

en: Besides, it is not hard to see that our time is a time of birth and of transition to a new period.
Spirit has broken with the world of its existence and of its representing as it has been so far, and is on the point of sinking it into the past, and is in the labour of reshaping itself.
True, it is never at rest, but is always in an ever-progressing movement.

But just as in the child, after long, silent nourishment, the first breath interrupts that gradualness of a merely increasing advance — a qualitative leap — and now the child is born, so the spirit that is forming itself ripens slowly and silently towards the new shape, dissolves one little piece of the structure of its preceding world after another, its tottering is indicated only by individual symptoms; the light-mindedness as well as the boredom that spread in what exists, the indeterminate presentiment of something unknown, are harbingers that something else is drawing near.
This gradual crumbling, which did not change the physiognomy of the whole, is interrupted by the rising, which, a lightning flash, in one stroke sets up the formation of the new world.
zh: 另外也不难看出，我们的时代是一个分娩的时代，是向一个新时期过渡的时代。
精神已经同它迄今为止的定在和表象的世界决裂，正要把它沉入过去，并处在自己改造的劳作中。
诚然它从来不曾静止，而总是处在不断前进的运动中。
但是，正如在孩子那里，经过长久的无声的滋养，第一口呼吸打断了那种只是不断增多的进展的渐次性——一个质的飞跃——这时孩子已经出生，正在形成自身的精神也同样缓慢而无声地向着新形态成熟，它把先前世界的结构一个零件接一个零件地分解掉，这个世界的动摇只由个别征兆暗示出来；在现存的东西中蔓延开来的轻浮和无聊，对某种未知之物的不确定的预感，都是另一个东西正在临近的先兆。
这种逐渐的碎裂并没有改变整体的面相，它被那升起的曙光打断，那曙光像一道闪电，一下子就立起了新世界的形态。

en: But this new thing has a complete actuality as little as the child just born; and this is essentially not to be left out of account.
Its first appearance is only its immediacy or its concept.
As little as a building is finished when its foundation has been laid, so little is the concept of the whole that has been reached the whole itself.
Where we wish to see an oak in the strength of its trunk and in the spreading of its branches and the masses of its foliage, we are not satisfied when, in place of it, an acorn is shown to us.
Thus science, the crown of a world of spirit, is not completed in its beginning.
The beginning of the new spirit is the product of a far-reaching upheaval of manifold formations of culture, the price of a much entangled path and of just as manifold exertion and effort.
It is the whole that has returned into itself out of succession as out of its extension, the simple concept of that whole which has become.

But the actuality of this simple whole consists in this, that those formations which have become moments develop and give themselves shape again anew, but in their new element, in the meaning that has become.
zh: 不过这个新东西和一个刚出生的孩子一样，还没有完整的现实性；这一点本质上不可不加注意。
它最初的出现还只是它的直接性或它的概念。
一幢建筑在它的地基已经打好时还没有完成，同样，已经达到的整体概念也不是整体本身。
我们想看到一棵橡树树干的强壮、枝条的伸展和枝叶的繁茂，若在我们面前拿一颗橡子来代替它，我们就不会满意。
同样，科学作为精神世界的王冠，在它的开端处也还没有完成。
新精神的开端是一场涉及面很广的、由多种多样教养形态构成的变革的产物，是一条缠绕多端的道路的代价，也是同样多重的辛劳和努力的代价。
它是从先后相继中、也从它的伸展中返回自身的整体，是这个整体已经生成了的简单概念。
但这个简单的整体的现实性却在于：那些已经变成环节的形态又重新在新的元素中、在已经生成了的意义中发展起来并取得形态。

en: Insofar as, on the one hand, the first appearance of the new world is only the whole veiled into its simplicity or its universal ground, so on the other hand the wealth of the preceding existence is still present to consciousness in recollection.

In the shape that newly appears it misses the unfolding and particularization of the content; but still more it misses the formation of the form, by which the differences are determined with security and ordered into their fixed relations.

Without this formation science lacks universal intelligibility and has the semblance of being an esoteric possession of a few individuals; — an esoteric possession: for it is present only in its concept or in its inner being; of a few individuals: for its unexpanded appearance makes its existence something individual.
Only what is completely determined is at the same time exoteric, intelligible and capable of being learned and of being the property of all.

The understanding's form of science is the path to it that is offered to all and made equal for all, and to arrive at rational knowledge through the understanding is the just demand of the consciousness that comes to science; for the understanding is thinking, the pure I in general; and what is intelligent is the already familiar and the common element of science and of the unscientific consciousness, whereby the latter is able to enter immediately into the former.
zh: 一方面，新世界的第一次显现还只是在它的单纯性中被包裹起来的整体，或它的普遍根据，另一方面，意识这里却还让先前定在的丰富内容在回忆中呈现着。
它在新出现的形态上感到缺少内容的展开和特殊化；但它更加感到缺少形式的塑造，只有靠这种塑造，那些差别才被可靠地规定下来，并被安排进它们固定的关系里。
没有这种塑造，科学就缺少普遍的可理解性，并且有这样一种假象，仿佛它是少数个别的人的一种秘密财产；——是一种秘密财产：因为它还只存在于它的概念里或它的内部；是少数个别的人的：因为它那未展开的现象把它的定在弄成了个别的东西。
只有完全被规定了的东西，才同时是通俗的、可理解的，并且能够被学习、能够成为所有人的财产。
科学那种知性的形式，是向所有人提供出来、为所有人变得平等的那条通向科学的道路，而凭借知性去达到理性的知识，是向科学走来的意识所提出的正当要求；因为知性就是思维，就是一般的纯粹自我；而知性的东西则是科学和非科学的意识已经熟悉的东西、共同的东西，非科学的意识由此就能直接进入科学。

en: The science that is only beginning and has therefore as yet brought it neither to the completeness of the detail nor to the perfection of the form, is exposed to censure on that account.
But if this censure is to hit its essence, it would be just as unjust as it is inadmissible to refuse to acknowledge that demand for formation.
This opposition seems to be the chief knot in which scientific culture is at present wearing itself out and about which it does not yet properly understand itself.
The one part insists on the wealth of the material and on intelligibility, the other at least disdains the latter and insists on immediate rationality and divinity.

Even if that part has been brought to silence, whether by the power of truth alone or also by the vehemence of the other, and even if it felt itself overpowered in regard to the ground of the matter, it is for that reason not satisfied in regard to those demands; for they are just, but not fulfilled.

Let its silence belong only half to victory, but half to the boredom and indifference that are wont to be the consequence of a constantly aroused expectation and of the promises that have not been fulfilled.
zh: 这门科学才刚刚开始，因此既还没有达到细节的完整性，也还没有达到形式的完善性，所以它难免要受到这方面的指责。
但这种指责若要击中它的本质，就会同样不公正，正如不承认那种塑造的要求是站不住脚的一样。
这个对立看来是当前科学教养在上面磨损自己的那个最主要的结，而且它对这个结还没有真正理解清楚。
一方强调材料的丰富和可理解性，另一方至少看不起后者，强调直接的理性性和神性。
即使那一方已经被弄得沉默下来——不管是单凭真理的力量，还是也靠另一方的猛烈——即使它在事情的根据方面感到自己被压倒了，它也并未因此就在那些要求方面得到满足；因为那些要求是正当的，却没有被兑现。
它的沉默不妨说只有一半属于胜利，另一半却属于无聊和冷淡，而无聊和冷淡往往是不断被激起的期待和没有兑现的许诺所带来的后果。

en: In regard to the content, the others indeed sometimes make it easy enough for themselves to have a great extension.

They draw onto their ground a quantity of material, namely what is already known and ordered, and in that they set themselves chiefly to do with the oddities and curiosities, they seem all the more to possess the rest, with which knowledge in its own way was already finished, and at the same time to master what is still unregulated and thus to subject everything to the absolute idea, which herewith seems to be recognized in everything and to have grown into an extended science.

But looked at more closely, this expansion shows itself not to have come about in that one and the same thing had shaped itself differently, but it is the formless repetition of one and the same thing, which is only externally applied to the different material and receives a tedious semblance of difference.
The idea, which is indeed true in itself, in fact only ever stays at its beginning, if the development consists in nothing but such a repetition of the same formula.

The one unmoved form, carried around by the knowing subject over what is present, the material dipped into this resting element from outside, this is as little as arbitrary notions about the content the fulfilment of what is demanded, namely the wealth that springs from itself and the difference of the shapes that determines itself.
It is rather a one-coloured formalism, which arrives at the difference of the material only because this material is already prepared and known.
zh: 在内容方面，另一些人有时倒是很轻易地就拥有一种很大的扩展。
他们把一大堆材料，也就是已经熟悉、已经安排好的东西，拉到自己的地盘上来，而由于他们主要去弄那些古怪和稀罕的东西，他们就显得更加占有了其余那些知识在其本来的方式上早已弄完的东西，同时也支配了那还没有被整理的东西，于是就把一切都归到绝对观念之下，而绝对观念在此似乎就在一切东西中被认识到，并且已经长成了一门扩展开了的科学。
但更仔细地看这种扩展，它显示出来并不是这样形成的，即同一个东西把自己塑造成了不同的样子，相反，它是同一个东西的无形态的重复，而这个东西只是被外在地套用到不同的材料上，并且获得了一种无聊的差别的假象。
那个自在地固然是真的观念，如果发展只在于对同一个公式作这样一种重复，那么它事实上永远只是停留在自己的开端上。
那唯一不动的形式被进行认识的主体拿到现有的东西上转来转去，材料被从外面浸入这个静止的元素，这就像关于内容的任意念头一样，并不就是被要求的东西的兑现，即从自身涌出的丰富和自行规定自身的形态差别。
这倒是一种单色的形式主义，它之所以达到材料的差别，只是因为这种材料已经被准备好了、已经被熟悉了。

en: In doing so he asserts this monotony and the abstract universality to be the absolute; he assures us that to be unsatisfied in it is an incapacity to take possession of the absolute standpoint and to hold fast to it.

If formerly the empty possibility of representing something to oneself in another way as well sufficed to refute a representation, and the same mere possibility, the general thought, also had the whole positive value of actual cognition, then here too we see all value ascribed to the general idea in this form of unreality, and the dissolution of the distinguished and the determinate, or rather the casting down of the same into the abyss of the void — a casting down no further developed and not justifying itself in the thing itself — passing for the speculative way of looking at things.

To consider any determinate being as it is in the absolute consists here in nothing other than saying of it that it has indeed just now been spoken of as something: in the absolute, however, the A = A, there is no such thing at all, but everything is one therein.

To set this one knowledge, that in the absolute everything is equal, over against the distinguishing and fulfilled, or fulfilment-seeking and fulfilment-demanding, cognition, or to pass off one's absolute as the night in which, as the saying goes, all cows are black, is the naiveté of emptiness at cognition.

– The formalism that the philosophy of modern times accuses and has decried, and which has generated itself again within it, will not disappear from science, even if its inadequacy is known and felt, until the cognition of absolute actuality has become perfectly clear about its nature.

– In the respect that the general representation, when it precedes what is an attempt at its execution, makes the comprehension of the latter easier, it is useful to indicate here approximately what it comes to, with the intention at the same time of removing on this occasion some forms whose habitual use is an obstacle to philosophical cognition.
zh: 他这样一来就把这种单调和抽象普遍性说成绝对者；他保证说，在其中感到不满足，是一种无能，无能于占有绝对立场并在它上面坚持住。
如果说从前单凭那种空洞的可能性——把某物也以另一种方式表象出来——就足以驳倒一个表象，而同样这种单纯的可能性、即一般思想，也曾拥有现实认识的全部正面价值，那么我们在这里同样看到：一切价值都被归给处于这种非现实性形式中的一般观念，而对有差别者和被规定者的消解，或者说，把后者抛进空洞的深渊——这种抛入既没有得到进一步的展开，也不曾在它自身那里为自己作出辩护——则被视为思辨的考察方式。
考察任何一种定在，看它在绝对者中怎样，在这里无非就是说：它固然刚才还被当作某个东西来谈论，但在绝对者、即 A = A 中，却根本没有这类东西，那里一切都是一。
把这样一种知识——在绝对者中一切都相同——拿去与有差别的、充实了的、或者寻求并要求充实的认识相对立，或者把自己的绝对者说成黑夜，而按通常的说法，在黑夜里所有母牛都是黑的，这就是认识上的空洞的天真。
——近代哲学所指责、诟病、并且在它自身中又重新产生出来的形式主义，即使它的不充分为人所知、被人感觉到，也不会从科学中消失，直到对绝对现实性的认识完全弄清了自己的本性为止。
——考虑到一般表象如果先于对它的实施所作的那种尝试，就会使对后者的领会变得容易，在这里大致点出它的情况是有益的，目的同时也在于借此机会清除某些形式，这些形式的习惯用法对哲学认识是一种障碍。

en: In my view, which must justify itself only through the presentation of the system itself, everything depends on grasping and expressing the true not as substance but just as much as subject.

At the same time it is to be noted that substantiality includes within itself just as much the universal, or the immediacy of knowledge itself, as also that immediacy which is being, or immediacy, for knowledge.

– If to grasp God as the one substance outraged the age in which this determination was expressed, the ground of this lay partly in the instinct that in it self-consciousness has only perished, not been preserved, but partly the opposite, which thinking as thinking holds fast, is the universality as such, the same simplicity or undifferentiated, unmoved substantiality; and if, thirdly, thinking unites the being of substance with itself and grasps immediacy or intuition as thinking, then it still depends on whether this intellectual intuition does not again fall back into inert simplicity and present actuality itself in an unreal way.
zh: 照我的见解——这种见解只能靠体系本身的阐述来为自己作出辩护——，关键全在于：把真的东西不作为实体、而是同样作为主体来把握和表述。
同时要指出，实体性在自己之内既包含普遍的东西、即知识本身的直接性，也包含那种对知识而言构成存在、或者说构成直接性的直接性。

——如果说把上帝把握为一个实体曾使那个说出这一规定的时代感到愤怒，那么这一点的原因，部分在于那种本能，即自我意识在其中只是沉没了，并没有被保存下来；但部分说来，思维作为思维所坚持的那种对立面，即作为这样的普遍性，却是同样的单纯性、或者说无差别的、不动的实体性；而如果第三，思维把实体的存在与自己结合起来，把直接性或直观当作思维来把握，那么问题还在于，这种智性直观是否不会又落回惰性的单纯性，并以一种非现实的方式把现实性本身表现出来。

en: Further, the living substance is being which is in truth subject, or, what means the same, which is in truth actual, only insofar as it is the movement of positing itself, or the mediation of becoming-other with itself.

As subject it is pure simple negativity, and precisely thereby the bifurcation of the simple; or the opposing doubling, which again is the negation of this indifferent difference and of its opposition: only this self-restoring sameness, or the reflection in otherness within itself — not an original unity as such, or an immediate one as such — is the true.
It is the becoming of itself, the circle that presupposes its end as its purpose and has it as its beginning, and is actual only through the execution and its end.
zh: 此外，活的实体是这样一种存在：它在真理中就是主体，或者说——这说的是同一回事——它在真理中就是现实的，但仅仅就它是自我设定的运动、或者说自身变为他者与自身的中介而言。
它作为主体是纯粹单纯的否定性，正因此就是单纯者的分裂；或者说，是设置对立的那种加倍，而这种加倍又是对这种漠不相关的差异性及其对立的否定：只有这种自身恢复着的等同，或者说在他在中回到自身之内的反思——不是作为这样的原初统一，也不是作为这样的直接统一——才是真的东西。
它是自身的生成，是一个圆圈，这个圆圈把自己的终点预设为自己的目的并把它作为开端，而且只有通过实施和自己的终点才是现实的。

en: The life of God and divine cognition may thus well be expressed as a play of love with itself; this idea sinks down to edification and even to insipidity if the seriousness, the pain, the patience and the labour of the negative are missing in it.
In itself that life is indeed the untroubled sameness and unity with itself, which is in no earnest about otherness and estrangement, nor about the overcoming of this estrangement.
But this in-itself is the abstract universality in which abstraction is made from its nature, to be for itself, and thereby from the self-movement of form altogether.

If form is asserted as equal to essence, it is precisely for that reason a misunderstanding to mean that cognition can content itself with the in-itself or the essence and spare itself the form — that the absolute principle or the absolute intuition makes the execution of the former or the development of the latter dispensable.

Just because form is as essential to essence as essence is to itself, it is not merely as essence, i.e. as immediate substance or as the pure self-intuition of the divine, that it is to be grasped and expressed, but just as much as form and in the whole wealth of the developed form; only thereby is it grasped and expressed as actual.
zh: 上帝的生命和神圣的认识，因此尽可以说成爱与自己的一场游戏；但如果其中缺少否定者的严肃、痛苦、耐心和劳作，这个观念就降格为说教，甚至降格为平淡乏味。
自在说来，那种生命诚然是与自身未受搅扰的等同和统一，它并不认真对待他在和异化，也不认真对待对这种异化的克服。
但这种自在是抽象的普遍性，在其中人们抽掉了它自为存在的本性，因而也完全抽掉了形式的自我运动。
如果形式被说成与本质等同，那么正因如此，认为认识可以满足于自在或本质、却省掉形式，就是一种误解——认为绝对原理或绝对直观使前者的实施或后者的展开成为多余。
正因为形式对本质来说就像本质对自己本身一样本质，所以它不能仅仅作为本质、即作为直接的实体或作为神性的纯粹自我直观来把握和表述，而是同样要作为形式、并且在展开了的形式的全部丰富性中来把握和表述；只有这样，它才被当作现实的东西来把握和表述。

en: The true is the whole.
But the whole is only the essence that completes itself through its development.
It is to be said of the absolute that it is essentially result, that it is only at the end what it is in truth; and precisely in this consists its nature, to be actual, subject, or self-becoming.
However contradictory it may seem that the absolute is to be comprehended essentially as result, a little reflection nevertheless sets this semblance of contradiction right.
The beginning, the principle, or the absolute, as it is first and immediately expressed, is only the universal.

Just as little as the word “all animals” can count as a zoology when I say it, so it is striking that the words of the divine, the absolute, the eternal, etc. do not express what is contained in them; – and only such words in fact express intuition as the immediate.
What is more than such a word, the transition even to a single proposition, contains a becoming-other that must be taken back, is a mediation.

But it is this mediation that is abhorred, as if by the fact that more is made of it than only this, that it is nothing absolute and is not at all in the absolute, absolute cognition would be given up.
zh: 真的东西就是整体。
但整体只是通过自己的展开而把自己完成起来的本质。
必须就绝对者说：它本质上是结果，它只有在终点才是在真理中它所是的那个东西；而它的本性恰恰就在于此，即它是现实的东西、是主体、或者说就是自身生成。
说绝对者本质上要作为结果来以概念把握，这无论显得多么矛盾，稍加考虑就会把这种矛盾的假象纠正过来。
开端、原理或绝对者，作为最初并且直接地被说出来的东西，只是普遍的东西。
正如我说“一切动物”时，这个说法不能算作一部动物学，同样显眼的是，“神性的”“绝对的”“永恒的”等等词语并没有说出其中所包含的东西；——而只有这样的词语才确实把直观作为直接的东西表达出来。
任何多于这样一个词语的东西，即便只是过渡到一个命题，都包含一种必须被收回的他者生成，都是一种中介。
但中介恰恰是人们所厌弃的东西，仿佛只要从它那里弄出的东西多于这一点——即它不是任何绝对的东西、在绝对者中也根本没有它——，绝对认识就会被放弃似的。

en: This abhorrence, however, in fact comes from unfamiliarity with the nature of mediation and of absolute cognition itself.

For mediation is nothing other than self-sameness that moves itself, or it is reflection into itself, the moment of the I that is for itself, pure negativity, or, reduced to its pure abstraction, simple becoming.
The I, or becoming in general, this mediating, is by virtue of its simplicity precisely immediacy in the making, and the immediate itself.
– It is therefore a failure to recognize reason when reflection is excluded from the true and is not grasped as a positive moment of the absolute.

It is reflection that makes the true into a result, but it equally sublates this opposition to its becoming, for this becoming is equally simple and therefore not different from the form of the true, that of showing itself as simple in the result; it is rather precisely this having-returned into simplicity.
– If the embryo is indeed a human being in itself, it is not so for itself; it is so for itself only as formed reason, which has made itself into what it is in itself.
Only this is its actuality.
But this result is itself simple immediacy, for it is self-conscious freedom, which rests in itself and has not put the opposition aside and left it lying there, but is reconciled with it.
zh: 不过，这种畏惧其实来自对中介以及绝对认识本身的性质缺乏了解。
因为中介不是别的，就是自己运动着的自身等同，或者说，它就是在自身中的反思，是自为存在着的我这个环节，是纯粹否定性，或者，被归结为它的纯粹抽象，就是单纯的生成。
我，或者说一般的生成，这种中介，正因为它的单纯性，恰恰就是生成着的直接性，就是直接的东西本身。
——所以，如果反思被排除在真的东西之外，不被把握为绝对者的一个积极环节，那就是误解了理性。
正是反思把真的东西变成了结果，但它同样扬弃了这种针对它的生成的对立，因为这种生成同样单纯，因此与真的东西在结果中把自己显示为单纯这一形式没有区别；它毋宁说恰恰就是这种已经返回到单纯性之中的状态。
——胚胎固然自在地是人，但它并不是自为地是人；它只有作为有教养的理性才是自为地是人，而这种理性已经把自己造就成了它自在地所是的东西。
只有这一点才是它的现实性。
但这个结果本身就是单纯的直接性，因为它是自我意识着的自由，这种自由安息在自身之中，它没有把对立撇到一边、让它搁在那里，而是与它和解了。

en: What has been said can also be expressed thus, that reason is purposive activity.
The exaltation of the supposed nature over misjudged thinking, and first of all the banishment of external purposiveness, has brought the form of purpose in general into discredit.
But just as Aristotle too determines nature as purposive activity, the purpose is the immediate, the resting, the unmoved, which is itself moving; so it is subject.
Its power to move, taken abstractly, is being-for-itself, or pure negativity.

The result is the same as the beginning only because the beginning is purpose; – or the actual is the same as its concept only because the immediate, as purpose, has the self, or pure actuality, in itself.

The purpose that has been carried out, or the actual that has determinate being, is movement and unfolded becoming; but it is precisely this unrest that is the self; and it is equal to that immediacy and simplicity of the beginning because it is the result, what has returned into itself — but what has returned into itself is precisely the self, and the self is the equality and simplicity that relates itself to itself.
zh: 上面所说的也可以这样来表达：理性就是合目的的活动。
把所谓的自然抬高到被误解的思维之上，以及首先把外在的合目的性驱逐出去，这使一般的目的形式名声扫地。
不过，正如亚里士多德也把自然规定为合目的的活动，目的是直接的东西、静止的东西、不动的而自身却在运动着的东西；这样，目的就是主体。
它运动的力，抽象地看，就是自为存在，或者就是纯粹否定性。
结果之所以和开端是同一个东西，只是因为开端就是目的；——或者说，现实的东西之所以和它的概念是同一个东西，只是因为直接的东西作为目的，在它自身中拥有自我，或者拥有纯粹的现实性。
实现出来了的目的，或者定在着的现实的东西，是运动和展开了的生成；但这种不安息恰恰就是自我；它之所以和开端的那种直接性和单纯性相等同，是因为它就是结果，就是回返到自身之中的东西，——而回返到自身之中的东西恰恰就是自我，而自我就是自己与自己相关联的等同和单纯性。

en: The need to represent the absolute as subject availed itself of the propositions: God is the eternal, or the moral world order, or love, and so on.
In such propositions the true is only straightway posited as subject, but is not presented as the movement of self-reflection into itself.
In a proposition of this kind one begins with the word “God”.
This, for itself, is a senseless sound, a mere name; only the predicate says what it is, is its fulfilment and meaning; the empty beginning becomes an actual knowing only in this end.

In this respect it is impossible to see why one should not speak solely of the eternal, the moral world order, and so on, or, as the ancients did, of pure concepts, being, the one, and so on, of what the meaning is, without still adding the senseless sound.
But it is precisely by this word that it is indicated that what is posited is not a being or essence or universal in general, but something reflected into itself, a subject.
But at the same time this is only anticipated.

The subject is assumed as a fixed point, to which the predicates are fastened as to their support, through a movement that belongs to the one who knows it and that is also not regarded as belonging to the point itself; but only through it would the content be presented as subject.
In the way this movement is constituted, it cannot belong to it; but on the presupposition of that point it also cannot be otherwise constituted, it can only be external.

That anticipation, that the absolute is subject, is therefore not only not the actuality of this concept, but even makes it impossible; for the former posits it as a resting point, while the latter is self-movement.
zh: 要把绝对者表象为主体的那种需要，用的是这样一些命题：上帝是永恒者，或者是道德的世界秩序，或者是爱，等等。
在这样的命题里，真的东西只是被直截了当地设定为主体，而不是被表述为在自身中反思自身的那种运动。
在这种命题里，人们是从“上帝”这个词开始的。
它自为地是一个无意义的声音，一个单纯的名字；只有谓词才说出它是什么，才是它的充实和意义；空洞的开端只有在这个终点才成为一种现实的知识。
就此而言，看不出为什么不可以只谈永恒者、道德的世界秩序等等，或者像古人那样只谈纯粹的概念，谈存在、太一等等，只谈那个就是意义的东西，而不必再加上那个无意义的声音。
但正是通过这个词才表明：被设定的不是一种存在、本质或一般意义上的普遍者，而是一个在自身中反思着的东西，一个主体。
不过同时，这只是被预先设定了。
主体被假定为一个固定的点，诸谓词作为它们的支撑被系在这个点上，而这是通过一种运动发生的；这种运动属于那个对它有所知的人，而人们也不认为它属于这个点本身；但只有通过这种运动，内容才会被表述为主体。
就这种运动本身的性质而言，它不可能属于这个点；但既然那个点是被预先设定的，这种运动也就不可能有别的性质，只能是外在的。
那种预先设定，即绝对者是主体，因此不仅不是这个概念的现实性，反而还使这种现实性成为不可能；因为那种预先设定把概念设定为一个静止的点，而现实性却是自我运动。

en: Among the various consequences that flow from what has been said, this one can be singled out: that knowing is actual and can be presented only as science or as system; that furthermore a so-called fundamental proposition or principle of philosophy, if it is true, is already for that very reason also false, insofar as it is only as fundamental proposition or principle.
– It is therefore easy to refute it.
The refutation consists in showing its deficiency; but it is deficient because it is only the universal or principle, the beginning.
If the refutation is thorough, it is taken from it itself and developed — not brought about by opposing assurances and notions from outside.

It would therefore properly be its development and hence the completion of its deficiency, if it did not misrecognize itself in this, that it attends only to its negative activity and does not also become conscious of its progress and result on their positive side.

– The proper positive execution of the beginning is at the same time, conversely, just as much a negative comportment toward it, namely toward its one-sided form of being at first immediate or purpose.

It can thus likewise be taken as a refutation of that which constitutes the ground of the system; but more correctly it is to be regarded as a showing that the ground or principle of the system is in fact only its beginning.
zh: 从上面所说的话引出的种种结论中，可以挑出这样一条：知识只有作为科学、或者作为体系才是现实的，也才能被表述出来；其次，一条所谓的哲学原则或原理，如果它是真的，那么单凭它只是作为原则或原理这一点，它也就同样是假的。
——所以，要驳倒它是很容易的。
驳斥在于指出它的缺陷；而它之所以有缺陷，是因为它只是普遍的东西或原理，只是开端。
如果驳斥是彻底的，那它就是从它自身中取得并发展出来的，——不是靠相反的断言和从外面来的念头制造出来的。
所以，它本来就会是它的发展，从而补足它的缺陷，如果它不是在这上面误认了自己，即只注意自己那种否定的活动，而不也按积极的一面意识到自己的进程和结果。
——开端真正的积极展开，同时反过来也同样是针对它的一种否定态度，即针对它那个片面的形式：起初是直接的，或者是目的。
因此它同样可以被看作是对构成体系根据的东西的驳斥；但更确切地说，它应当被看作一种指明：体系的根据或原理事实上只是它的开端。

en: That the true is actual only as system, or that substance is essentially subject, is expressed in the representation that pronounces the absolute as spirit — the most sublime concept, and one that belongs to the modern age and its religion.

The spiritual alone is the actual; it is the essence or the in-itself-existing — the self-relating and determinate, otherness and being-for-itself — and what in this determinacy or in its being-outside-itself remains within itself; — or it is in and for itself.
— But this being-in-and-for-itself is at first only for us, or in itself: it is the spiritual substance.

It must also be this for itself; it must be the knowledge of the spiritual and the knowledge of itself as spirit, i.e. it must be an object to itself, but equally immediately a sublated, inwardly reflected object.

It is for itself only for us, insofar as its spiritual content is produced by it itself; but insofar as it is also for itself for itself, this self-producing, the pure concept, is for it at the same time the objective element in which it has its determinate being, and in this way it is, in its determinate being, for itself an object reflected into itself.
— Spirit which, thus developed, knows itself as spirit, is science.
It is its actuality and the realm that it builds for itself in its own element.
zh: 真的东西只有作为体系才是现实的，或者说实体本质上就是主体，这一点是在那种把绝对者说成精神的表象里表达出来的——这是最崇高的概念，也是属于近代及其宗教的概念。
只有精神的东西才是现实的；它就是本质或自在存在者——是自身关联着的、被规定的东西，是他在和自为存在——并且是在这种规定性中或在自己的外在中仍然守在自己那里的东西；——或者说，它是自在自为的。
——但这种自在自为存在起初只是为我们、或者说只是自在的：它是精神的实体。
它也必须自为地成为这一点，必须是关于精神的东西的知识，也是关于自己作为精神的知识，也就是说，它必须对自己成为对象，但同样也是直接的、已被扬弃的、在自身中反思的对象。
它只是对我们来说才是自为的，只要它那精神的内容是由它自己产生出来的；但既然它也自为地为自己而存在，那么这种自我产生、即纯粹的概念，对它同时就是那种对象性的要素，它在其中拥有自己的定在，而它就这样在自己的定在中自为地是在自身中反思的对象。
——这样发展起来、并作为精神而知自身的精神，就是科学。
它是它的现实性，也是它在自己的要素中为自己建造起来的王国。

en: Pure self-cognition in absolute otherness, this ether as such, is the ground and soil of science, or knowledge in general.
The beginning of philosophy makes the presupposition or demand that consciousness be in this element.
But this element itself receives its completion and transparency only through the movement of its becoming.
It is pure spirituality as the universal that has the manner of simple immediacy; — this simple [element], as it has existence as such, is the ground, the thinking, that is only in spirit.

Because this element, this immediacy of spirit, is the substantial in general of spirit, it is the transfigured essentiality, the reflection that is itself simple and is immediacy as such for itself, the being that is reflection into itself.
Science, for its part, demands of self-consciousness that it have raised itself into this ether in order to be able to live with it and in it, and to live.
Conversely, the individual has the right to demand that science reach him the ladder at least to this standpoint, and show him that standpoint in himself.

Its right is grounded in its absolute independence, which it knows it possesses in every shape of its knowledge; for in every one — whether it be recognized by science or not, and whatever the content may be — it is the absolute form, i.e. it is the immediate certainty of itself and, if this expression were preferred, thereby unconditional being.

If the standpoint of consciousness — to know of objective things in opposition to itself and of itself in opposition to them — counts for science as the other, as that in which it knows itself to be at home with itself, or rather as the loss of spirit, then conversely the element of science is for it a distant beyond in which it no longer possesses itself.
Each of these two parts seems to the other to be the perversion of truth.

That natural consciousness entrusts itself immediately to science is an attempt that it makes — it does not know drawn by what — to walk on its head for once; the compulsion to assume this unaccustomed posture and to move in it is a violence, as unprepared as it seems unnecessary, that it is expected to inflict on itself.

— Let science be in itself what it will; in relation to immediate self-consciousness it presents itself as something inverted over against it; or, because the latter has in the certainty of itself the principle of its actuality, science bears the form of unreality, since the latter is for itself outside it.
It must therefore unite such an element with itself, or rather show that and how it belongs to it itself.
As thus lacking actuality, it is only the content as the in-itself, the purpose, which is as yet only something inner, not [yet] as spirit, only as yet spiritual substance.
This in-itself has to express itself and to become for itself; this means nothing other than: it has to posit self-consciousness as one with itself.
zh: 在绝对他在中的纯粹自我认识，这个作为这样的以太，就是科学的基础和基地，或者说一般意义上的知识。
哲学的开端作出这样的前提或要求：意识就处在这个要素之中。
但这个要素本身只有通过它自己的生成的运动才获得自己的完成和透明性。
它是纯粹的精神性，是那种具有单纯直接性方式的一般东西；——这个单纯的东西，作为这样的东西而拥有存在，就是基地，就是思想，而思想只有在精神中才存在。
因为这个要素、这种精神的直接性，是精神的一般实体性的东西，所以它就是变得澄明的本质性，就是那种本身单纯、自为地就是作为这样的直接性的反思，就是那种自身即反思的存在。
科学从自己这方面要求自我意识：它已经把自己提升到了这个以太之中，为的是能够与它一起、在它之中生活，并且真正地生活。
反过来，个体有权要求科学至少把梯子递到这一立场，并在他自己身上向他指出这一立场。
它的权利建立在自己的绝对独立性之上，它知道自己在它的知识的每一种形态中都拥有这种独立性；因为在每一种形态里——不管它是否为科学所承认，也不管内容是什么——它都是绝对的形式，也就是说，它是自己本身的直接的确定性，而如果人们更愿意用这个说法，它由此就是无条件的存在。
如果意识的立场——即知道对象性的物与自身对立、并且知道自己与它们对立——在科学看来是另一种东西，是意识在其中知道自己与自身同在的东西，不如说是精神的丧失，那么反过来，科学的要素对意识来说就是一个遥远的彼岸，在那里它不再拥有自己。
这两方中的每一方，在另一方看来都显得是真理的颠倒。
自然意识对科学的直接的托付，是它所作的一次尝试——它不知道自己是被什么吸引——也来一次头朝下走路；强迫它采取这种不习惯的姿势并在其中活动，是一种既无准备又显得多余的暴力，人们要求它对自己施加这种暴力。
——科学自在地可以是它愿意的任何东西；但在与直接的自我意识的关系中，它把自己表现为一种与后者相颠倒的东西；或者说，因为后者在自己本身的确定性中拥有自己现实性的原则，所以科学就带有非现实性的形式，因为后者自为地处在它之外。
因此它必须把这样一种要素与它自己结合起来，或者不如说，必须指出这种要素是属于它自己的，以及它是怎样属于的。
由于这样地缺少现实性，它就只是作为自在的内容，只是那个目的，这个目的暂时还是一种内在的东西，还不是作为精神，暂时还只是精神的实体。
这个自在必须表现出来，并且成为自为的；这无非是说：它必须把自我意识设定为与它自己合而为一。

en: It is this becoming of science in general, or of knowledge, that this Phenomenology of Spirit presents.
Knowledge as it is at first, or immediate spirit, is the spirit-less, sensuous consciousness.
In order to become genuine knowledge or to produce the element of science, which is its own pure concept, it has to work its way through a long path.

— This becoming, as it will set itself forth in its content and in the shapes that show themselves in it, will not be what one at first imagines under a guidance of unscientific consciousness to science, and is also something other than the grounding of science, — let alone the enthusiasm that begins immediately, as if shot from a pistol, with absolute knowledge, and is already done with other standpoints by declaring that it takes no notice of them.
zh: 科学一般或知识的这种生成，正是这部《精神现象学》所展示的东西。
知识最初的样子，或者说直接的精神，是无精神的东西，是感性的意识。
为了成为本来意义上的知识，或者为了产生科学的要素——这要素就是科学自己的纯粹的概念——它必须沿着一条漫长的道路把自己劳作出来。
——这种生成，按照它将在自己的内容中、以及在它之中显现出来的那些形态中把自己摆出来的样子，将不会是人们最初在一种从非科学意识通向科学的引导之下所设想的东西，也不等于对科学的论证，——更不用说那种热情了：它像从手枪里射出来一样，以绝对知识为直接的开端，并且凭着宣布对其他立场不加理会，就已经把它们了结了。

en: The task of leading the individual from his uneducated standpoint to knowledge had to be grasped in its general sense, and the universal individual, the self-conscious spirit, had to be considered in its formation.
— As regards the relation of the two, there shows itself in the universal individual each moment as it gains concrete form and its own configuration.
The particular individual is the incomplete spirit, a concrete shape in whose entire determinate being one determinacy is dominant and in which the others are present only in blurred traits.

In the spirit that stands higher than another, the lower concrete determinate being has sunk down to an inconspicuous moment; what previously was the matter itself is now only a trace; its shape is veiled and has become a simple shading.

This past the individual, whose substance is the higher-standing spirit, runs through in the manner in which one who undertakes a higher science goes through the preparatory cognitions that he has long possessed, in order to make their content present to himself; he calls back the recollection of them without having his interest and his tarrying therein.

The single individual must also, as regards content, run through the stages of formation of the universal spirit, but as shapes already laid aside by the spirit, as stages of a path that has been worked out and leveled; thus, with regard to cognitions, we see what in earlier ages occupied the mature spirit of men sunk down to cognitions, exercises and even games of boyhood, and in the pedagogical progression we shall recognize the history of the formation of the world as it were traced in silhouette.
This past determinate being is already the acquired property of the universal spirit, which constitutes the substance of the individual and, thus appearing to it as external, its inorganic nature.

— Formation in this respect, considered from the side of the individual, consists in its acquiring this existing material, consuming its inorganic nature within itself and taking it into possession for itself.
But from the side of the universal spirit as substance this is nothing other than that the latter gives itself its self-consciousness, brings forth its becoming and its reflection into itself.
zh: 要把个体从他那个未受教养的立场引向知识，这一任务必须按其一般的意义来把握，而一般的个体、即自我意识的精神，则必须在其教养中来考察。
——至于两者的关系，在一般的个体身上，每一个环节都显示出自己是怎样获得具体的形式和自己特有的形态的。
特殊的个体是不完整的精神，是一个具体的形态，在它的整个定在中，有一种规定性起支配作用，而在其中其余的规定性只以模糊的特征存在着。
在比另一个精神站得更高的精神里，那较低的具体的定在已经降为一个不显眼的环节；先前曾是事情本身的东西，如今只是一道痕迹；它的形态被包裹起来，变成了一种单纯的色调。
这个过去，那以更高的精神为自己的实体的个体是以这样的方式经历它的：就像一个着手研究一门更高科学的人，为了把那些他早已掌握的准备性的知识的内容对自己当下化，而把这些知识过一遍；他唤回对它们的回忆，却并不在其中拥有自己的兴趣和停留。
单个的人按内容来说也必须经历一般精神的各个教养阶段，不过这些阶段是精神已经卸下的形态，是一条已经修好、已经铺平的道路的各个阶段；这样，我们就知识方面看到，早先时代里曾占据成年人的成熟精神的东西，已经降为少年时代的知识、练习乃至游戏，并且我们将在教育的进展中认出那仿佛是照着剪影描摹下来的世界教养的历史。
这个过去的定在已经是一般精神获得的财产，而这精神构成个体的实体，并且在这样对它显得外在时构成它的无机自然。
——就这一方面而言，教养从个体这一方面来看就在于：它把这种现成的东西据为己有，把它的无机自然吸收到自己之内，并为己而占有它。
但从作为实体的一般精神这一方面来看，这无非是说：这实体把它的自我意识给予自己，产生出它的生成和它在自身中的反思。

en: Science presents both this formative movement in its elaborateness and necessity and also what has already sunk down to a moment and property of spirit, in its configuration.
The goal is the spirit's insight into what knowledge is.
Impatience demands the impossible, namely the attainment of the goal without the means.

On the one hand, the length of this path is to be endured, for every moment is necessary; — on the other hand, one must tarry with each, for each is itself an individual whole shape and is considered absolutely only insofar as its determinacy is considered as a whole or concrete, or the whole in the peculiarity of this determination.

— Because the substance of the individual, because even the world-spirit had the patience to go through these forms in the long extension of time and to take upon itself the enormous labor of world history, in which it shaped out in each the entire content of its substance, of which the latter is capable, and because it could attain consciousness of itself through no lesser labor, the individual can indeed, as regards the matter, not comprehend its substance with less; meanwhile it has at the same time less trouble, because in itself this is accomplished, the content is already actuality extinguished into possibility, immediacy subdued, the configuration already brought down to its abbreviation, to the simple determination of thought.

Already a thought, the content is the property of substance; what has to be converted is no longer determinate being into the form of being-in-itself, but only the in-itself — no longer merely original nor sunk into determinate being, but rather already recollected — into the form of being-for-itself.
The manner of this doing is to be specified more closely.
zh: 科学既把这种教养的运动在其详尽展开和必然性中展示出来，也把已经降为精神的环节和财产的东西在其形态中展示出来。
目标是精神对什么是知识的识见。
不耐烦要求不可能的东西，即没有手段就达到目标。
一方面，这条道路的漫长必须忍受，因为每一个环节都是必然的；——另一方面，必须停留在每一个环节上，因为每一个环节本身都是一个个别的、完整的形态，并且只有当一个环节的规定性被当作整体或具体的东西来考察，或者整体被在这种规定性的特有性中被考察时，它才被绝对地考察。

——因为个体的实体、甚至世界精神曾经有耐心，在时间的漫长延展中把这些形态走一遍，并且承担起世界历史的巨大劳动——在每一个形态里，它都把它的实体的全部内容、即这实体所能有的全部内容塑造出来——，又因为它只有通过同样不小的劳动才能达到关于自己的意识，所以，就事情本身来说，个体固然不能以更少的劳动去以概念把握自己的实体；但同时它也有较小的辛苦，因为这件事自在地已经完成了，内容已经成了被抹去而化为可能性的现实性、被制服的直接性，形态也已经被归结为它的缩写，归结为单纯的思想规定。
内容既然已经是被思考的东西，就是实体的财产；需要转变的不再是定在进入自在存在的形式，而只是那个既不再是单纯原初的、也不复是沉入定在之中的、而是已经被回忆起来的自在，进入自为存在的形式。
这种做法的方式还必须更切近地加以说明。

en: What is spared of the whole at the standpoint at which we take up this movement here is the sublating of determinate being; but what still remains and needs higher transformation is representation and acquaintance with the forms.

The determinate being taken back into substance is by that first negation only just immediately transferred into the element of the self; this property acquired by it therefore still has the same character of uncomprehended immediacy, of unmoved indifference as determinate being itself; the latter has thus only passed over into representation.
— At the same time it is thereby something known, something with which existing spirit has finished, in which therefore its activity and hence its interest is no longer present.

If the activity that finishes with determinate being is itself only the movement of the particular spirit that does not comprehend itself, then knowledge, by contrast, is directed against the representation that has thereby come about, against this being-known; it is the doing of the universal self and the interest of thinking.
zh: 在我们于这里采取这一运动所站的那个立场上，整体中被省去的东西是定在的扬弃；但还剩下的、并且需要更高改造的东西，是表象以及对各种形式的熟悉。
被收回实体之中的定在，通过那第一个否定只是刚刚直接地被移入自我的要素之中；这个为它获得的财产因此还带有与定在本身相同的性格，即未被以概念把握的直接性、不动的漠不关心的性格；定在这样就只是转入了表象。
——同时它由此成了一个熟知的东西，一个定在着的精神已经与之了结的东西，因此精神的活动、从而它的兴趣都不再在其中。
如果与定在打交道并把定在了结的活动，本身只是特殊的、不以概念把握自己的精神的运动，那么知识则针对由此产生的表象，针对这种熟知状态；它是普遍的自我的行动，是思维的兴趣。

en: The known in general is for that very reason, because it is known, not cognized.

It is the most ordinary self-deception as well as deception of others, in cognizing to presuppose something as known and to let it please one just the same; with all the talking back and forth, such knowledge, without knowing how it happens to it, does not get off the spot.

Subject and object etc., God, nature, the understanding, sensuousness etc. are without examination presupposed as known and as something valid, and make fixed points both of the starting out and of the return.
The movement goes back and forth between them, which remain unmoved, and thus proceeds only on their surface.
Thus apprehension and examination also consist in seeing whether everyone also finds what is said of them in his representation, whether it seems so to him and is known, or not.
zh: 一般意义上的熟知的东西，正因为它是熟知的，所以并没有被认识。
这是最常见的自我错觉，也是对他人的错觉：在认识时把某种东西预设为熟知的，并且同样听之任之；任凭怎么来回议论，这样的知识也不知道自己是怎么回事，就是寸步不前。
主体和客体等等、上帝、自然、知性、感性等等，都不加审视地被当作熟知的、当作有效的东西而设为前提，并且构成出发和返回的固定点。
运动在它们之间来来回回，而它们保持不动，因此只在它们的表面上发生。
这样，把握和检验也就在于看：每个人是否也在自己的表象中找到关于它们所说的东西，这对他说来是否显得如此、是否为他所熟知，或者不是。

en: The analysis of a representation, as it used to be carried on, was already nothing other than the sublation of the form of its familiarity.

To lay out a representation into its original elements is to go back to its moments, which at least do not have the form of the representation as it is encountered, but constitute the immediate property of the self.
This analysis admittedly arrives only at thoughts that are themselves familiar, fixed and resting determinations.
But this separated, unreal [element] itself is an essential moment; for only because the concrete separates itself and makes itself unreal is it the self-moving.
The activity of separating is the force and labour of the understanding, the most astonishing and the greatest, or rather the absolute power.
The circle that rests closed within itself and, as substance, holds its moments, is the immediate and therefore not astonishing relation.

But that the accidental, separated from its circumference, as such, the bound element that is actual only in its connection with another, gains a determinate being of its own and a separated freedom, this is the tremendous power of the negative; it is the energy of thought, of the pure I.
Death, if we care to call that unreality so, is the most frightful thing, and to hold fast to what is dead is what requires the greatest force.
Powerless beauty hates the understanding, because it demands of it what it is unable to do.

But not the life that shies away from death and keeps itself purely preserved from devastation, but the life that endures death and maintains itself in it, is the life of spirit; it wins its truth only in that it finds itself in absolute tornness.

It is not this power as the positive that looks away from the negative, as when we say of something that it is nothing or false, and then, finished with it, pass over from it to something else; on the contrary, it is this power only in that it looks the negative in the face and tarries with it, this tarrying is the magic power that turns it into being.

— It is the same as what was called the subject above, which, in that it gives determinacy a determinate being in its element, sublates the abstract immediacy, that is, the immediacy that merely is in general, and is thereby the true substance, the being or the immediacy that does not have mediation outside it but is this mediation itself.
zh: 对一种表象的分析，照从前所做的那样，本来就无非是扬弃它的熟知状态的形式。
把一种表象分解成它的原始要素，就是回溯到它的那些环节，这些环节至少不具有那个现成遇到的表象的形式，而是构成自我的直接财产。
这种分析虽然只达到一些思想，而这些思想本身是熟知的、固定的、静止的规定。
但这个被分离出来的、非现实的东西本身却是一个本质的环节；因为只有具体的东西把自己分开、把自己变成非现实的东西，它才是自身运动着的东西。
分离的活动是知性的力和劳作，而知性是最令人惊奇的、最伟大的力量，或者不如说是绝对的力量。
那个自身封闭地静止着、并作为实体保持着自己的诸环节的圆圈，是直接的、因而并不令人惊奇的关系。
但那个从自己的范围中被分离出来的偶然的东西，作为这样的东西，那个被束缚的、只有在自己与另一个东西的联系中才是现实的东西，赢得自己的定在和分离出来的自由，这就是否定的巨大力量；它是思想、纯粹自我的能量。
死亡，如果我们愿意这样称呼那种非现实性的话，就是最可怕的东西，而固守住死的东西，则是需要最大的力的事情。
无力的美憎恨知性，因为知性向它要求它做不到的事情。
但精神的生命并不是那种在死亡面前畏缩、让自己完全不受毁灭的生命，而是那种忍受死亡、并且在死亡中保持自己的生命，它只有在绝对的撕裂中找到了自己，才赢得自己的真理。
它拥有这种力量，并不是作为那种对否定视而不见的肯定东西，就像我们说某个东西是虚无的或者虚假的，然后就把它了结，离开它转向别的什么东西；相反，它只有正视否定、在否定那里停留，才拥有这种力量，而这种停留就是那种把否定变成存在的魔力。
——它就是上面被称为主体的那个东西，它在让规定性在自己的要素中获得定在这一点上，扬弃了那种抽象的、也就是仅仅一般地存在着的直接性，并因此而是真正的实体，也就是那种不是在自己之外拥有中介、而是本身就是这种中介的存在或直接性。

en: That the represented becomes the property of pure self-consciousness, this elevation to universality in general, is only the one side, not yet completed formation.
— The manner of study of ancient times has this difference from that of modern times, that the former was the proper thorough formation of natural consciousness.
Testing itself in particular at every part of its determinate being, and philosophizing about everything that came along, it produced itself into a universality active through and through.

In modern times, by contrast, the individual finds the abstract form prepared; the effort to grasp it and make it its own is more the unmediated driving-forth of the inner and the cut-off producing of the universal than a coming-forth of the latter out of the concrete and the manifoldness of determinate being.

Now, therefore, the labour consists not so much in purifying the individual from the immediate sensuous manner and making it into a thought-out and thinking substance, as rather in the opposite: through the sublation of fixed, determinate thoughts, to actualize and spiritualize the universal.
It is, however, far harder to bring fixed thoughts into fluidity than sensuous determinate being.

The ground is what was indicated earlier: those determinations have the I, the power of the negative, or pure actuality, as the substance and element of their determinate being; the sensuous determinations, by contrast, have only the powerless abstract immediacy or being as such.

Thoughts become fluid in that pure thinking, this inner immediacy, recognizes itself as a moment, or in that the pure certainty of itself abstracts from itself — not letting itself go, setting itself aside, but giving up the fixedness of its self-positing, both the fixedness of the pure concrete, which the I itself is in opposition to a differentiated content, and the fixedness of differentiated things that, posited in the element of pure thinking, have a share in that unconditionedness of the I.
Through this movement the pure thoughts become concepts and only then are what they are in truth: self-movements, circles, that which their substance is, spiritual essences.
zh: 被表象的东西成为纯粹自我意识的财产，这种向一般普遍性的提升，只是一个方面，还不是完成了的教养。
——古代的学习方式与近代的学习方式有这样一种差别：前者是对自然意识的本来意义上的彻底教养。
它在自己定在的每一个部分上都分别地尝试自己，并且对遇到的一切都作哲学思考，从而把自己生成为一个彻头彻尾地活动着的普遍性。
与此相反，在近代，个体发现抽象的形式已经现成地准备好了；把握它并把它变为己有的努力，更是内在东西的无中介的向外逼出、是普遍东西的被切断了的产生，而不是普遍东西从具体东西和定在的杂多性中产生出来。
所以现在的工作与其说在于把个体从直接的感性方式中清洗出来、使它成为被思想的并且思想着的实体，不如说在于相反的事情：通过扬弃那些固定的、被规定的思想，使普遍的东西成为现实的、并且使它具有精神。
但是，把固定的思想变得流动起来，要比把感性的定在变得流动起来困难得多。
原因就是前面已经指出的东西；那些规定以自我、以否定的力量或者纯粹的现实性作为它们定在的实体和要素；相反，感性的规定则只以没有力量的抽象直接性或者存在本身作为它们定在的实体和要素。
思想变得流动起来，是因为纯粹的思想、这种内在的直接性认识到自己是一个环节，或者是因为自己本身的纯粹确定性从自己那里抽象出来——并不是把自己丢开、搁到一边，而是放弃自己设定自己的固定性，既放弃纯粹具体东西的固定性，这纯粹具体东西就是与有区别的内容相对立着的自我本身，也放弃那些有区别的东西的固定性，这些东西被设定在纯粹思想的要素中，就分有自我那种无条件性。
通过这种运动，纯粹的思想变成概念，并且这时才成为它们在真理中所是的东西，即自身运动、圆圈，即它们实体的东西，即精神的本质。

en: This movement of the pure essences constitutes the nature of scientific character in general.
Considered as the connection of its content, it is the necessity and expansion of that content into an organic whole.

The path by which the concept of knowledge is reached becomes through it likewise a necessary and complete becoming, so that this preparation ceases to be a contingent philosophizing that attaches itself, as contingency brings it about, to this or that object, relation and thought of the imperfect consciousness, or seeks through a to-and-fro reasoning, inferring and concluding from determinate thoughts to ground the true; on the contrary, this path will, through the movement of the concept, encompass the complete worldliness of consciousness in its necessity.
zh: 纯粹本质的这种运动，构成了一般意义上的科学性的本性。
就它被看作其内容的联系而言，它就是这种内容的必然性和向有机整体的展开。
知识的概念借以达到的那条道路，通过这种运动同样成为一种必然的和完整的生成，以至于这种准备不再是一种偶然的哲学活动，这种活动随偶然性所至而依附于不完善的意识的这种或那种对象、关系和思想，或者通过一种来回摆动的推理、推论和推导，试图从被规定的思想出发为真的东西奠立根据；相反，这条道路将通过概念的运动，把意识的完整的世间性连同其必然性一起包揽进来。

en: Such a presentation further constitutes the first part of science, because the determinate being of spirit as the first is nothing other than the immediate or the beginning, but the beginning is not yet its return into itself.
The element of immediate determinate being is therefore the determinacy by which this part of science distinguishes itself from the others.
— The statement of this difference leads to the discussion of some fixed thoughts that habitually occur here.
zh: 这样一种展示之所以进一步构成科学的第一部分，是因为精神作为最初东西的定在，无非就是直接的东西或者开端，而开端还不是它向自身的返回。
因此，直接的定在的要素就是规定性，科学的这个部分正是通过这种规定性与别的部分区别开来。
——说明这种差别，会引出对一些固定思想的讨论，而这些思想在这里通常会出现。

en: The immediate determinate being of spirit, consciousness, has the two moments of knowledge and of the objectivity that is negative with respect to knowledge.
Insofar as spirit develops itself in this element and unfolds its moments, this opposition belongs to them, and they all appear as shapes of consciousness.
The science of this path is the science of the experience that consciousness makes; substance is considered as it and its movement are its object.
Consciousness knows and comprehends nothing but what is in its experience; for what is in this experience is only the spiritual substance, and indeed as the object of its self.
But spirit becomes object, for it is this movement: to become an other for itself, i.e. the object of its self, and to sublate this otherness.

And it is precisely this movement that is called experience, in which the immediate, the unexperienced, i.e. the abstract — whether of sensuous being or of the merely thought simple — estranges itself and then returns out of this estrangement to itself, and thereby is now first presented in its actuality and truth and is also the property of consciousness.
zh: 精神的直接定在，即意识，有两个环节：知识，以及对于知识来说是否定性的对象性。
精神在这个要素中发展自身、展开它的诸环节时，这种对立就属于这些环节，而它们全都作为意识的形态出现。
这条道路的科学，就是意识所作的经验的科学；而实体是这样被考察的：它以及它的运动怎样是意识的对象。
意识除了在它的经验之中的东西以外，什么也不知道，也不以概念把握什么；因为在这经验之中的东西，只是精神的实体，而且是作为它自己的自我的对象。
但精神成为对象，因为它就是这种运动：为自己成为一个他者，也就是成为它自己的自我的对象，并扬弃这种他在。
而经验恰恰被叫作这样一种运动：在其中，直接的东西、未被经验的东西，也就是抽象的东西，不管是感性存在的抽象，还是仅仅被思维到的单纯东西的抽象，把自己异化，然后从这种异化中回到自身，并且因此现在才在它的现实性和真理中被呈现出来，同时也成为意识的财产。

en: The inequality that takes place in consciousness between the I and the substance that is its object is their difference, the negative in general.

It can be regarded as the defect of both, but is their soul, or the moving principle in them; which is why some of the ancients conceived the void as the moving principle, in that they grasped the moving principle indeed as the negative, but did not yet grasp this as the self.
— If now this negative at first appears as the inequality of the I with the object, it is just as much the inequality of substance with itself.
What seems to proceed outside it, to be an activity against it, is its own doing, and it shows itself to be essentially subject.

In having shown this completely, spirit has made its determinate being equal to its essence; it is object to itself as it is, and the abstract element of immediacy and of the separation of knowledge and truth is overcome.
Being is absolutely mediated; — it is substantial content that is just as immediately the property of the I, self-like, or the concept.
With this the Phenomenology of Spirit concludes.
What he prepares for himself in it is the element of knowledge.
In this element the moments of spirit now spread out in the form of simplicity, which knows its object as itself.

They no longer fall apart into the opposition of being and knowledge, but remain in the simplicity of knowledge, are the true in the form of the true, and their diversity is only diversity of content.
Their movement, which organizes itself in this element into a whole, is logic or speculative philosophy.
zh: 在意识中，「我」与实体之间——实体是「我」的对象——发生的那种不等同，就是它们的差别，就是一般意义上的否定的东西。
它可以被看作两者的缺陷，但它是两者的灵魂，或者说是在它们之中推动着的东西；正因如此，某些古人以概念把虚空把握为推动者，因为他们虽然把推动者把握为否定的东西，却还没有把这种否定的东西把握为自我。
——如果这个否定的东西起初表现为「我」与对象的不等同，那么它同样也是实体与自身的不等同。
凡是在它之外进行着、看起来是针对它的一种活动的东西，都是它自己的行动，而它表明自己本质上就是主体。
在它完全表明了这一点之后，精神就把自己的定在弄得与自己的本质相同了；它对自己来说就是对象，就是它本来所是的样子，而直接性、以及知识与真理相分离的那个抽象要素，已经被克服了。
存在是绝对地被中介了的；——它是实体性的内容，这内容同样直接地是「我」的财产，是自我性的，或者说就是概念。
至此，《精神现象学》就结束了。
他在其中为自己准备起来的，是知识的要素。
在这个要素中，精神的诸环节现在以简单性的形式展开，而简单性把自己的对象知为它自己本身。
它们不再分裂为存在与知识的对立，而是留在知识的简单性之中，是真的东西在真的东西的形式之中，而它们的差异只是内容上的差异。
它们的运动在这个要素中把自己组织成为整体，这个运动就是逻辑学，或者说思辨哲学。

en: Now since that system of the experience of spirit comprises only the appearance of spirit, the advance from it to the science of the true — which is in the shape of the true — seems to be merely negative, and one might want to be spared the negative as the false and demand to be led to the truth without further ado; why bother with the false?
— To what was already spoken of above, that one should begin immediately with science, the answer is to be given here from the side of what character the negative as false has in general.
The representations about this mainly obstruct the entrance to truth.
This will give occasion to speak of mathematical cognition, which non-philosophical knowledge regards as the ideal that philosophy would have to strive to reach, but has so far striven for in vain.
zh: 既然精神的经验的那个体系只包含精神的现象，那么从它向真的东西的科学——而这个真的东西处在真的东西的形态之中——的进展，就显得纯粹是否定性的，而人们就可能想免掉作为假的东西的否定的东西，并要求径直被引向真理；何必去跟假的东西打交道呢？
——上面已经谈到，应当马上就从科学开始，对此，这里要从作为假的东西的否定的东西一般具有怎样的性质这一方面来回答。
关于这件事的表象，尤其阻碍着通向真理的入口。
这将给出机会，来谈谈数学的认识，非哲学的知识把它看作理想，哲学必须努力达到这个理想，但迄今为止却徒劳地努力着。

en: The true and the false belong among the determinate thoughts that count as motionless entities of their own, of which the one stands over there, the other over here, isolated and fixed, without community with the other.
By contrast, it must be asserted that the truth is not a minted coin that can be given ready-made and thus pocketed.
Nor is there a false, any more than there is an evil.

The evil and the false are indeed not as bad as the devil, for as the devil they are even made into a particular subject; as false and evil they are only universals, yet they still have their own essentiality over against one another.
— The false (for here only of it is the talk) would be the other, the negative of substance, which as content of knowledge is the true.
But substance is itself essentially the negative, partly as distinction and determination of the content, partly as a simple distinguishing, i.e. as self and knowledge in general.
One can indeed know falsely.
Something is known falsely, means that knowledge is in inequality with its substance.
But precisely this inequality is distinguishing in general, which is an essential moment.
Out of this distinction there indeed comes their equality, and this equality that has come to be is the truth.

But it is not truth in such a way as if the inequality had been thrown away like the dross from the pure metal, nor even in the way the tool stays away from the finished vessel, but the inequality, as the negative, as the self in the true as such, is itself still immediately present.
It cannot, however, be said on that account that the false constitutes a moment or even a component of the true.
That in every false thing there is something true — in this expression both count like oil and water, which, immiscible, are only externally connected.
Precisely for the sake of the meaning, to designate the moment of complete otherness, their expressions must no longer be used where their otherness is sublated.

Just as the expression of the unity of subject and object, of the finite and the infinite, of being and thought, etc., has the awkwardness that object and subject, etc., mean what they are outside their unity, are therefore not meant in the unity as what their expression says, so the false is no longer, as false, a moment of the truth.
zh: 真的东西和假的东西属于那些被规定的思想，这些思想不动地被当作自有的本质，它们当中一个在那边、另一个在这边，与另一个没有共同性，孤立而固定地站着。
与此相反，必须主张这一点：真理不是一枚铸好的硬币，可以被现成地给出，就这样揣进口袋。
也同样没有假的东西，正如没有恶一样。
恶和假固然没有魔鬼那么坏，因为作为魔鬼，它们甚至被弄成了一个特殊的主体；作为假的东西和恶的东西，它们只是普遍的东西，但彼此之间却各有自己的本质性。
——假的东西（因为这里只谈它）会是实体的他者，是实体的否定的东西，而实体作为知识的内容就是真的东西。
但实体本身本质上就是否定的东西，一方面作为内容上的区分和规定，另一方面作为一种单纯的区分，也就是作为自我和一般意义上的知识。
人确实可能错误地知道。
某物被错误地知道，这就是说，知识处于与它的实体不等同的状态。
但恰恰这种不等同就是一般意义上的区分，而区分是本质性的环节。
从这种区分中确实产生出它们的等同，而这种生成起来的等同就是真理。
但它并不是这样地是真理：好像不等同已经被扔掉，像矿渣从纯金属上被扔掉那样；也不是像工具从做成的器皿上分离出去那样；相反，不等同作为否定的东西、作为在真的东西本身之中的自我，本身还是直接地存在着。
但不能因此就说，假的东西构成了真的东西的一个环节，甚至构成了它的一个组成部分。
每一个假的东西里都有某种真的东西，——在这个说法里，两者就像油和水一样被看待，而油和水不能混合，只是外在地被联结在一起。
正因为含义是要标示出完全的他在这一环节，它们的表达在它们的他在已被扬弃的地方就不该再被使用。
正如主体与客体、有限与无限、存在与思维等等的统一的表达有一个别扭之处，即客体与主体等等意味着它们在它们的统一之外所是的东西，所以在统一之中也就不是被意谓为它们的表达所说的东西，同样，假的东西不再作为假的东西而是真理的环节。

en: The dogmatism of the way of thinking in knowledge and in the study of philosophy is nothing other than the opinion that the true consists in a proposition that is a fixed result, or that is also immediately known.

To such questions — when Caesar was born, how many toises a stadium amounted to, and so on — a neat answer is supposed to be given, just as it is definitely true that the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the two other sides of the right-angled triangle.
But the nature of such a so-called truth is different from the nature of philosophical truths.
zh: 在知识和哲学研究中，思维方式上的独断论不是别的，就是这样一种意见：真的东西存在于一个命题之中，而这个命题是一个固定的结果，或者也是直接被知道的。
对于这样一些问题：凯撒是什么时候出生的、一个斯塔德等于多少图瓦兹等等，应当给出一个明确的回答，正如直角三角形斜边的平方等于另外两条边的平方之和，这一点是确定地真的。
但这种所谓真理的本性，不同于哲学真理的本性。

en: With regard to historical truths, to mention them briefly, insofar namely as what is purely historical in them is considered, it is easily conceded that they concern the individual determinate being, a content viewed on the side of its contingency and arbitrariness, determinations of it that are not necessary.
— But even such bare truths as those cited as examples are not without the movement of self-consciousness.

In order to know one of them, much must be compared, books must also be looked up, or it must be investigated in whatever way it may be; even in the case of an immediate intuition, only the knowledge of it together with its grounds is held to be something that has true value, although properly only the bare result is supposed to be what is at issue.
zh: 就历史真理来说——为了简短地提到它们——，也就是说，只要考察其中纯粹历史性的东西，人们就容易承认，它们涉及个别的定在，涉及就偶然性和任意性那一面来看的内容，涉及内容的一些并非必然的规定。
——但即便是那些作为例子举出的赤裸真理，也不是没有自我意识的运动的。
为了知道其中一条，必须作许多比较，还要翻书查阅，或者不管用什么方式去研究；即便在直接的直观那里，也只有连同其根据一起的对它的知识，才被视为具有真的价值的东西，尽管本来应当成为关键所在的，只是那个赤裸的结果。

en: As for mathematical truths, even less would he be held to be a geometer who knew Euclid's theorems by heart without their proofs, without knowing them inwardly, as one might put it by way of contrast.
Likewise, the knowledge that one would acquire by measuring many right-angled triangles, namely that their sides have the familiar relation to one another, would be held to be unsatisfactory.
However, even in mathematical cognition the essentiality of the proof does not yet have the meaning and nature of being a moment of the result itself; rather, in the result it is past and vanished.
As a result, the theorem is indeed something recognized as true.

But this added circumstance does not concern its content, but only the relation to the subject; the movement of the mathematical proof does not belong to what is the object, but is an activity external to the matter.

Thus the nature of the right-angled triangle does not itself decompose in the way it is presented in the construction that is necessary for the proof of the proposition expressing its relation; the entire producing of the result is a course and means of cognition.
— Also in philosophical cognition, the becoming of determinate being as determinate being is different from the becoming of the essence or of the inner nature of the matter.
But philosophical cognition contains, first, both, whereas the mathematical contains only the becoming of determinate being, i.e. of the being of the nature of the matter in cognition as such.
Secondly, the former also unites these two particular movements.

The inner arising, or the becoming of substance, is inseparably a passing over into the external or into determinate being, being for another, and conversely the becoming of determinate being is the taking-itself-back into essence.

The movement is thus the doubled process and becoming of the whole, in such a way that at the same time each posits the other and each therefore also has both on it as two views; together they thereby make the whole: they dissolve themselves and make themselves into its moments.
zh: 就数学真理来说，谁要是把欧几里得的定理背得出来，却没有它们的证明，没有——像人们在对比中可能说的那样——从内部知道它们，那就更不会被看作几何学家了。
同样，一个人通过测量许多直角三角形而获得的知识，即它们的边彼此具有那种已知的比例关系，也会被认为是不能令人满意的。
然而，即使在数学认识中，证明的本质性也还不具有成为结果本身的一个环节这一含义和本性，相反，在结果里它倒是已经过去、已经消失了。
作为结果，定理诚然是一种被认作真的东西。
但这个附加的情况并不涉及它的内容，而只涉及与主体的关系；数学证明的运动并不属于行动对象的东西，而是一种对事情来说外在的活动。
所以，直角三角形的本性并不像它在那种为证明那个表达其比例关系的命题所必需的构造中展示的那样自行分解；结果的全部产生过程，都是认识的一种进程和手段。
——在哲学认识中，定在作为定在的生成，也不同于本质、或者说事情内在本性的生成。
但哲学认识首先包含二者，而数学认识则只展示定在的生成，也就是说，只展示事情的本性在作为这样的认识之中的存在。
其次，前者也把这两种特殊的运动统一起来。
内在的产生、或者说实体的生成，不可分割地就是向外部、向定在、向他存在的过渡，而反过来，定在的生成就是把自身收回到本质中去。
运动就这样是双重的过程、是整体的生成，以至于同时每一方都设定另一方，因此每一方自身也具有二者，作为两种视角；它们合起来由此构成整体：它们自己消解自己，并把自己变成整体的环节。

en: In mathematical cognition, insight is an activity external to the matter; from this it follows that the true matter is thereby altered.
The means, construction and proof, therefore indeed contains true propositions; but it must equally be said that the content is false.
In the above example the triangle is torn apart and its parts are struck into other figures that the construction lets arise on it.
Only at the end is the triangle restored, which is properly what is at issue, which was lost from sight in the course of it and occurred only in pieces that belonged to other wholes.

— Here we see therefore also the negativity of the content enter in, which would just as well have to be called a falsity of it as, in the movement of the concept, the vanishing of the thoughts that are meant as fixed.
zh: 在数学认识中，识见是一种对事情来说外在的活动；由此得出，真的事情会因此被改变。
手段，即构造和证明，因此诚然包含真的命题；但同样必须说，内容是虚假的。
在上述例子里，三角形被撕开，它的各个部分被敲打成另外一些图形，而这些图形是构造在它身上产生出来的。
直到最后，三角形才被重新恢复出来，而本来关键所在的正是它，它在进程中却从视野里丢失了，只以一些碎块的形式出现，而这些碎块还属于别的整体。
——所以，我们在这里也看到内容的否定性出现，它同样必须被称为内容的虚假性，正如在概念的运动中，那些被意谓为固定的思想的消失也必须如此。

en: But the proper deficiency of this cognition concerns both cognition itself and its material in general.
— As far as cognition is concerned, in the first place the necessity of the construction is not seen.

It does not follow from the concept of the theorem, but is commanded, and one has to obey this prescription blindly — to draw precisely these lines, of which infinitely many others could be drawn — without knowing anything further than to have the good faith that this will be expedient for conducting the proof.
Afterwards, then, this expediency also shows itself, which is for that reason only an external one, because it shows itself only afterwards, in the proof.
— Likewise, the latter proceeds along a path that begins somewhere, one does not yet know in what relation to the result that is supposed to come out.
Its progress takes up these determinations and relations and lets others lie, without one immediately seeing according to what necessity; an external purpose governs this movement.
zh: 但这种认识本来的缺陷，既涉及认识本身，也涉及它的一般材料。
——就认识来说，首先，构造的必然性并没有被识见到。
它不是从定理的概念中产生出来的，而是被命令的，而人们必须盲目地听从这条规定：恰好画出这些线，而本来还可以画出无穷多条别的线；除了抱有那种善良的信念、即相信这对引导证明会是合目的的之外，人们不知道任何更多的东西。
事后，这种合目的性也就表明出来，而它之所以只是一种外在的合目的性，是因为它要到事后、在证明中才表明出来。
——同样，这个证明也走着一条从某处开始的路，人们还不知道它与那个应当得出的结果处于什么关系。
它的进程采纳这些规定和关系，把另一些搁下，而人们并不能直接识见到这是按照何种必然性；一个外在的目的支配着这种运动。

en: The evidence of this defective cognition, on which mathematics prides itself and with which it also boasts over against philosophy, rests solely on the poverty of its purpose and the defectiveness of its material, and is therefore of a kind that philosophy must disdain.
— Its purpose or concept is magnitude.
This is precisely the inessential, concept-less relation.
The movement of knowing therefore proceeds on the surface, does not touch the matter itself, not the essence or the concept, and is therefore no comprehending.
— The material, over which mathematics bestows the gratifying treasure of truths, is space and the one.
Space is the determinate being into which the concept inscribes its differences as into an empty, dead element, in which they are likewise motionless and lifeless.
